name: local-only-pwa-template
description: Static PWA template: no server, all user state on the device, staging-to-prod promote flow on Vercel.

scripts.stamp: printf '{"build":%s,"commit":"%s","stamped":"%s ET"}' "$(git rev-list --count HEAD)" "$(git rev-parse --short HEAD)" "$(TZ=America/New_York date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M')" > public/build.json && cat public/build.json && echo
